d: Compact A/V switcher supporting four EasyIP Camera video feeds plus an HDMI source. 4x4 Dante Audio matrix (10x10 cross-point audio matrix). Concurrent 1080p/60 USB 3.0 and HDMI output. Flexible control options with serial, telnet, trigger, Vaddio Device Controller, and web control
